digest.component_or_area: completion verifier close wrapper instrumentation and phase timing
propositions: Direct monotonic timers must partition the close wrapper's synchronous phases (setup, reusable lookup, attempt/resume/finalization, handle resolution, dispatch) to account for the 237743.4 ms gap between verifier_call_ms and inner workflow total_ms without adding I/O, subprocess, network, lock, or traversal.

Wrapper phase timings plus explicit unattributed_verifier_ms must reconcile to verifier_call_ms with maximum 1 ms per phase discrepancy (10 ms cap total), with any residual emitted as unattributed rather than inferred causally.

Existing consumption, request, tool-call, llm_ms, det_ms, and total_ms metrics must remain unchanged; instrumentation adds only cheap counter increments and dictionary assignments on the existing COMPLETION_VERDICT payload.

Instrumentation must support optional metrics collector passthrough so existing callers without it remain unchanged and workload counts (attempts, resume rounds, drain passes) reuse existing traversal without extra operations.
